tips.q: What is the trending AI photo editing prompt?
tips.a: Right now the cinematic film look and the childhood-vs-now collage dominate Reels. Both pair a lighting cue (golden hour, key light), a lens cue (Portra 400, 50mm), and a grain cue. Combine all three in one prompt for instant viral aesthetic.

tips.q: How do I make Instagram AI photo edits?
tips.a: Upload a clean selfie to GPT Image 2 Studio, paste a trending prompt from this library, edit outfit and mood, then export at 1:1 for grid or 9:16 for stories. Each 1K edit costs 6 credits, so you can preview multiple aesthetics before posting.

tips.q: Can GPT Image 2 restyle a portrait?
tips.a: Yes — image-to-image is GPT Image 2's strongest mode. It preserves face geometry, hairstyle, and skin tone while restyling lighting, outfit, background, and lens treatment. Use prompts like 'restyle as cinematic film portrait, keep facial features exactly' for clean results.

tips.q: How do I keep the face recognizable in photo edits?
tips.a: Upload a high-resolution close-up rather than a full-body shot, add 'preserve facial features and hairstyle exactly' to the prompt, and avoid heavy stylization keywords like 'cartoon' or 'anime' that override likeness in favor of generic style.

faq.q: What is the best Instagram trending photo edit prompt for ChatGPT / GPT Image 2 right now?
faq.a: The 'cinematic film look' and 'collage with little version of yourself' are top trending in 2026 — both rely on GPT Image 2's image-to-image strength. Upload a selfie, paste our prompt template (subject + lighting + lens + grain + mood), and the model returns a viral-ready edit in under 30 seconds.

faq.q: Can GPT Image 2 do trending Instagram edits like ChatGPT?
faq.a: Yes — GPT Image 2 IS the image generation model behind these trends, but our Studio gives faster turnaround, no rate limits, and a credit system that's cheaper for high-volume creators. Same prompts, better infrastructure.

faq.q: How do I make my Instagram photo look aesthetic with AI?
faq.a: Three things matter: (1) lighting cue ('golden hour' / 'soft window light' / 'cinematic key light'), (2) lens cue ('shot on Portra 400' / '50mm f/1.4'), (3) atmosphere cue ('film grain' / 'dreamy haze' / 'dust particles'). Combine all three in your prompt and you get aesthetic instantly.

faq.q: Is GPT Image 2 free for Instagram photo editing?
faq.a: Yes — Studio offers free trial credits. Each edit at 1K resolution = 6 credits. Most viral edits look great at 1K (Instagram displays 1080×1080). Upgrade to 2K only when you want HD details for prints.

faq.q: Why does my AI edit not match the viral version on Instagram?
faq.a: Three common fixes: (1) most viral creators chain prompts (first set the scene, then refine outfit, then refine lighting), (2) upload a clear close-up not a full-body shot, (3) avoid copying the exact phrasing — paraphrase to your own face/outfit. Our prompt library has tested templates that work first try.
